set.body:
Phase D (architecture). The structural form of P8.A2's additive fix.

SchedMD explicitly distinguishes base states from state flags (https://slurm.schedmd.com/job_state_codes.html). core/Observation.scala:6 conflates them in one enum.

Model: StateToken plus an independently derived Terminality.

CRITICAL REFINEMENT (from the review, and it is right): some CLI surfaces show a FLAG in place of the hidden base state. ReportedState must therefore permit a report with NO known base token. It must NOT manufacture a base state merely to make the model total. A fabricated base state is exactly the kind of dishonest totality the codebase otherwise avoids.

Also folds in:
- docs/compatibility.md:95-97 promises unknown states, reasons, flags, fields and warnings are preserved. Make that true at the TYPED layer, not only in rawFields.
- ADR drift: docs/architecture/0006-site-scale.md:64 says sacct parses "JobIDRaw" array suffixes, while docs/compatibility.md:115-116 states JobIDRaw is DELIBERATELY not requested and SlurmParsersSuite.scala:276 asserts it never appears. ADR 0006 describes behavior the code forbids and a test guards against. Correct the ADR.

Blocked by P8.A2 only in the sense that A2 must ship first for the hang to be fixed early; if A2 slips, D3 subsumes it.
set.title: P8.D3: ReportedState as base token plus flags
